about: THE 1985 CITATION RATCHET (kb/Work PB4950, read by EditionCitationNet in tests/WiseOwl.Cobol.Tests.Conformance): code -> refusal id -> the exact number of diagnostic lines that refusal draws at --std 85 under that code which cite only a later edition's rule. A count that grows fails (a new site); one that shrinks fails until it is lowered here; an entry at 0 is removed. Measured 2026-11-17; it only shrinks.
